svg.title: The cap cuts one section, and the answer sits past it
svg.desc: Seven Markdown pages go through MarkdownNodeParser, which starts a new section at every heading, giving 67 sections. BM25Retriever indexes them, and search_chunks returns at most eight of them, each cut to its first 1,000 characters. A bar chart of all 67 section lengths shows that only one section, Stage 4 Truck Roll Approval in the fault runbook, is longer than the cut, at 1,944 characters. The answer to the deep_section question, a call 30 minutes before arrival, starts at character 1,445, so the RAG agent never sees it.
svg.text: The cap cuts one section, and the answer sits past it
66 of the 67 sections fit under search_chunks' 1,000-character cut. Stage 4 of the fault runbook does not.
a new section at every heading
THE 67 SECTIONS BM25 INDEXES, BY LENGTH
search_chunks returns nothing past this line
item 8, a call 30 minutes before arrival
